reviewer: ChatGPT GPT-5.6 Sol (independent senior product/engineering review, 2026-10-06)

reviewScope.summary: Independent review of the final ProgressPal navigation/information-architecture payload. The previously reviewed IA candidate was unchanged except for one bounded dev-only lockfile security remediation required by the repository-native release gate: source-map-js 1.2.1 was updated to 1.2.2. The complete lockfile diff was independently reviewed and changed only that package resolution. npm audit --audit-level=moderate returned zero vulnerabilities. The IA implementation, UX decisions, routing, persistence, schemas, PWA behavior and product scope were not reopened.
evidence: Frozen candidate identity reviewed: base fe2e9878d8417309a9cca517a84498a5f02c3c88; candidate 36f688b7c3c01c836be2f806f3d231c298cae2e8; root tree 43608b3218ef00d560ef7bcc63c4d10bbb0e8db8; branch feat/navigation-ia-consolidation; clean captured status. The independent evidence ZIP hash manifest was verified without mismatches.
The candidate range contains exactly two commits: 30f0bc0 refactor: consolidate primary navigation and 36f688b fix: keep programme selection within narrow viewports.

Production/source changes are bounded to the approved navigation semantics/order, learner-avatar Profile access, Campaign labels/client-side quest links, removal of redundant RPG header shortcuts, seven Programvareutvikling achievement display-title strings and a local narrow-screen onboarding/programme-selection overflow repair. No candidate change to package identity, service worker, database implementation, schema/domain contract or persistence model was found.

Persistent navigation implements the locked five-item order Home - Campaign - Focus - Awards - Insights. Resource/lesson context does not falsely mark Campaign active, and Profile remains reachable through a native React Router link on the learner avatar with an accessible name and visible focus treatment.
Achievement changes were reviewed as display-title-only: stable IDs, descriptions/rules, trigger/source relationships, persistence identity and programme bindings remain unchanged.

Campaign quest links use client-side routing into the existing resource route. RpgResourcePage reload behavior is keyed by itemId/programme scope and uses active/page-version checks around asynchronous load/save/refresh paths; no concrete stale-resource or stale-HUD state-integrity defect was established.

Committed IA regression coverage is discriminating rather than only snapshotting the new labels: it asserts exact primary-nav count/order/hrefs, absence of the removed Hero/Profile/Map primary entries, active-state behavior, Profile/avatar keyboard access, Campaign-to-resource navigation and narrow viewport geometry at 320, 360 and 384 px.
The mobile overflow repair is local: programme selection receives a scoped modifier and wrapping/single-column behavior at narrow widths rather than changing the generic checkbox primitive globally.
A physical Galaxy S22+ owner test had already passed before independent review. The independent review therefore did not substitute another implementation cycle for owner/device validation.
Independent disposition: no P0, P1 or P2 defect requiring repair before integration was found; review concluded INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS.

Final dependency-security remediation: package-lock.json changed only the node_modules/source-map-js resolution from 1.2.1 to 1.2.2, including its registry URL and integrity value; the dependency remained dev-only. npm audit --audit-level=moderate then reported zero vulnerabilities.

adversarialFindings.description: The committed suite does not contain a dedicated regression that navigates resource A to resource B sequentially in one mounted application session and then explicitly asserts both the second resource content and the relevant HUD state.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted as a non-blocking coverage gap for this payload. The reviewed implementation reloads on itemId, guards asynchronous work with active/page-version checks, resource-context HUD exposure is limited, progression-changing actions explicitly refresh shared HUD state, and the physical Galaxy S22+ owner test exercised sequential quest changes without reproducing stale data. Add a focused lifecycle regression later if this routing area is touched again.

adversarialFindings.description: docs/CURRENT_STATE.md in the reviewed payload still describes the physical-device and independent IA review as outstanding, which became stale when those gates completed.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted as non-runtime documentation debt rather than a reason to mutate the frozen IA payload. Any correction outside docs/release-reviews would change the payload tree and invalidate this review, so reconcile current-state documentation only in a separately reviewed successor change.

adversarialFindings.description: The independent evidence bundle contained the committed regression definitions and review summaries but did not freeze raw logs for every previously reported full-suite execution or the reported negative-control run.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted because the independent review did not treat those reported executions as dispositive proof: it inspected the committed tests and implementation directly, and the repository-native immutable release gate remains the required clean-environment certification for the evidence-only successor commit.

retrospective.summary: The final payload consists of the independently accepted IA candidate plus one bounded dev-only source-map-js lockfile security remediation required by the immutable release gate. The security patch was independently reviewed from its complete diff and cleared the audit that had been the sole remaining release blocker. No open P0, P1 or P2 product defect was identified. Decision: proceed to one final repository-native immutable release certification for this exact payload.
